note: The script asks for four graphics: the hook text, the name super, the hook line back as silent top text, and the ask text Comment “I'm in”. Every other row is captions only, and the logo end card is the client's.

mg.title: Apartment hook

text.main: WHY NOT JUST GET AN APARTMENT?

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top third: “WHY NOT JUST GET AN APARTMENT?” Cut on.
mg.use: Hook text in the top third. It cuts on at frame 1, so start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:05.

mg.title: Dwayne name super
mg.cue: Name super 00:03–00:05, small, lower left, above the captions: Dwayne Burks / Gateway Gaston.
mg.use: Name super from 00:03 to 00:05. Move it lower left, above the captions, and keep it small.

mg.title: Question comes back

text.main: “Why doesn't this guy just go get an apartment?”

mg.cue: On “that said,” the hook line comes back as silent top text, in quotes
mg.use: Silent top text, in quotes, with no repeat of his audio. Put it on at “that said,” and take it off on “Let that sink in” at the start of the next row.

mg.title: Comment I'm in
mg.cue: Ask text on screen: Comment “I'm in”. Big, center, on the word “comment”. Holds to the end card.
mg.use: Ask text, big, in the center. Put it on at the word “comment” and hold it until the end card at 00:45.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Logo swishes in (about 10 frames), settles, holds. Same animation on all 12 videos. Make it once, reuse it. Nothing under the logo.
mg.src: The Journey Home logo from the client's own slides in Dwayne's Day 2 pm.mov (uploaded 6 Oct 2026), as the script asks.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:45 after the last line and hold it to the end.
